workItems.title: Install corrected CIS and verify one current RM-08 criterion with unchanged-result reuse
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Through the unchanged explicit CIS invocation, observe the new exact source/artifact identity and preserved rollback. Project original canonical component identities plus accepted current module paths without amending the approved design bundle. One source-backed AC-10 reaches its original WORK-004, CIS.Configuration implementation, exact real check and actual current native receipt. A second unchanged verification launches no native tests; original reports, approvals, costs, recovery records and unrelated launch settings remain unchanged.
workItems.validation: Verify exact package/install SHA256s and --version through normal route; refresh current derived graph under the6GiB ceiling, inspect component and criterion paths/unmapped counts, run only the one existing ConfigurationCentralAcceptanceTests.PairedInitializationUnchangedAcceptanceAndExplicitRemovalKeepOneRootAndTheActualRevision MSTest case under a fresh native owner/profile, verify unchanged twice with zero extra launches, inspect bounded prepare/transition output and retained historical hashes. No broad product qualification or old-owner reopening.

workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Install the exact review-corrected source distribution through the unchanged explicit wrapper with byte-verified inventory and preserved rollback. Under this fresh owner run exactly the existing AC-10 acceptance case once, then verify unchanged with zero additional native launches. Preserve completed WORK-001, original reports and unrelated launch settings; no broader qualification is implied.
